name: io.github.sepehr071/sheypoor-mcp
title: Sheypoor Classifieds
description: Read-only Sheypoor (sheypoor.com) classifieds: search ads, ad details, price summaries.

environmentVariables.name: SHEYPOOR_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Sheypoor requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
